data.name: Aditi
data.gender_notes: Aditi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Boundless; free; the mother of the gods
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + diti, 'bound' — 'boundless, free'. Its root is Sanskrit a + diti. Aditi, the Vedic mother of the gods. Aditi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Boundless; free; the mother of the gods”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aditi expresses “Boundless; free; the mother of the gods”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + diti, 'bound' — 'boundless, free'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aditi total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
